name: Top Interview 150
source: LeetCode 'Top Interview 150' study plan (leetcode.com/studyplan/top-interview-150/), grouped as on that page

remove-element.title: Remove Element
remove-element.trigger: Remove all copies of a value in-place and return the new length
remove-element.linker: Slow write pointer k + fast read pointer i: copy nums[i] to nums[k] only when nums[i] != val

remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array-ii.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array II
remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array-ii.trigger: Sorted array, keep each value at most twice, in-place
remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array-ii.linker: Write pointer k; keep nums[i] if k < 2 or nums[i] != nums[k-2]

rotate-array.title: Rotate Array
rotate-array.trigger: Rotate array right by k steps with O(1) extra space
rotate-array.linker: k %= n, then reverse whole array, reverse first k, reverse remaining n-k

h-index.title: H-Index
h-index.trigger: Largest h with at least h papers having h+ citations
h-index.linker: Bucket counts[min(c, n)]; walk from n down accumulating papers until total >= h

length-of-last-word.title: Length of Last Word
length-of-last-word.trigger: Length of the final word, ignoring trailing spaces
length-of-last-word.linker: Index from the end: skip spaces, then count non-space characters

text-justification.title: Text Justification
text-justification.trigger: Pack words into lines of maxWidth, distribute spaces evenly, last line left-justified
text-justification.linker: Greedy take words while fit; gaps = words-1; base = spaces // gaps, extra spaces go to leftmost gaps

is-subsequence.title: Is Subsequence
is-subsequence.trigger: Can s be formed from t by deleting characters without reordering
is-subsequence.linker: Pointer i on s advances only on match while j walks t; answer is i == len(s)

game-of-life.title: Game of Life
game-of-life.trigger: Update a grid simultaneously from neighbour counts with O(1) extra space
game-of-life.linker: Encode transitions in place (1->0 as 2, 0->1 as 3) while counting 8 neighbours, then decode with % 2

ransom-note.title: Ransom Note
ransom-note.trigger: Can one string be built from the letters of another
ransom-note.linker: 26-slot count array from magazine; decrement per ransom letter, fail if any goes negative

contains-duplicate-ii.title: Contains Duplicate II
contains-duplicate-ii.trigger: Equal values within distance k of each other
contains-duplicate-ii.linker: HashMap {value: last index}; or a HashSet window of size k that evicts nums[i-k]

summary-ranges.title: Summary Ranges
summary-ranges.trigger: Sorted unique array → compress consecutive runs into 'a->b' strings
summary-ranges.linker: Start a run at i, extend while nums[j+1] == nums[j]+1, emit 'a' or 'a->b'

simplify-path.title: Simplify Path
simplify-path.trigger: Canonical Unix path with '.', '..' and repeated slashes
simplify-path.linker: Split on '/', push names, pop on '..', skip '' and '.', join with '/'

basic-calculator.title: Basic Calculator
basic-calculator.linker: Running result + sign; on '(' push (result, sign) and reset, on ')' pop and combine

populating-next-right-pointers-in-each-n.title: Populating Next Right Pointers in Each Node II
populating-next-right-pointers-in-each-n.trigger: Connect each node to its right neighbour on the same level, any binary tree, O(1) space
populating-next-right-pointers-in-each-n.linker: Walk the current level via next pointers while building the next level with a dummy head + tail

minimum-absolute-difference-in-bst.title: Minimum Absolute Difference in BST
minimum-absolute-difference-in-bst.trigger: Smallest difference between any two BST values
minimum-absolute-difference-in-bst.linker: In-order visit gives sorted values; track prev and min(curr - prev)

evaluate-division.title: Evaluate Division
evaluate-division.trigger: Given a/b = k ratios, answer x/y queries
evaluate-division.linker: Graph edge a→b weight k and b→a weight 1/k; DFS/BFS multiplying weights along the path

minimum-genetic-mutation.title: Minimum Genetic Mutation
minimum-genetic-mutation.trigger: Fewest single-character mutations from start to end using a bank
minimum-genetic-mutation.linker: BFS over strings; neighbours = change one char to A/C/G/T that is in the bank set

construct-quad-tree.title: Construct Quad Tree
construct-quad-tree.trigger: Build a quad tree from an n×n binary grid
construct-quad-tree.linker: Recurse on four quadrants; if all four children are leaves with the same value, merge into one leaf

maximum-sum-circular-subarray.title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
maximum-sum-circular-subarray.trigger: Max subarray sum when the array wraps around
maximum-sum-circular-subarray.linker: Answer = max(maxKadane, total - minKadane), unless every number is negative

find-first-and-last-position-of-element-.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
find-first-and-last-position-of-element-.trigger: Start and end index of a target in a sorted array in O(log n)
find-first-and-last-position-of-element-.linker: Two binary searches: lower_bound(target) and lower_bound(target + 1) - 1

add-binary.title: Add Binary
add-binary.linker: Walk both strings from the end with a carry; append (sum % 2), carry = sum // 2, reverse

bitwise-and-of-numbers-range.title: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range
bitwise-and-of-numbers-range.trigger: AND of every integer in [left, right]
bitwise-and-of-numbers-range.linker: Shift both right until equal (their common prefix), then shift back left

max-points-on-a-line.title: Max Points on a Line
max-points-on-a-line.trigger: Most points lying on one straight line
max-points-on-a-line.linker: For each anchor point, count slopes as reduced (dy/g, dx/g) pairs in a HashMap

triangle.title: Triangle
triangle.trigger: Minimum path sum from top to bottom of a triangle
triangle.linker: Start from the last row: dp[j] = row[j] + min(dp[j], dp[j+1]); answer dp[0]
